references.text: Heshbon is mentioned as a city that Israel captured from Sihon, king of the Amorites.
These cities, including Heshbon, Elealeh, Nebo, and Sibmah, were later rebuilt by the tribe of Reuben.
Nebo is mentioned as the mountain where Moses was to view the Promised Land before his death.
The prophecy against Moab mentions several of the same cities: Dibon, Nebo, Heshbon, and Elealeh.
Sibmah and Jazer are mentioned in the prophecy against Moab, the same cities as in Numbers 32:3.
Jeremiah's prophecy against Moab mentions Nebo and Heshbon as cities that will be destroyed.
Dibon, Nebo, and Kirjathaim are mentioned in the judgment against Moab.
Jazer, Sibmah, Heshbon, and Elealeh are mentioned in Jeremiah's lament over Moab.
